title: OneNote: Copilot Chat can create, edit and refine notebook content
summary: The briefing's rollout, platform scope and planned notebook actions match the roadmap and Microsoft's notice. The Frontier licensing and roles are documented; the two navigation paths reach the correct settings pages but could include the final access controls.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Settings > View all > Copilot Frontier reaches the Frontier access settings page.

claims.fix: The path reaches the correct settings page but stops before the access controls. Extend it to 'Copilot > Settings > View all > Copilot Frontier > Turn on Frontier > Specific users and groups' for selective enrolment, as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/manage/get-started-frontier; retain the existing docs link, which documents the Frontier part of the route.
